title: Commercial Terms of Service
note: Ref [4]. §B ownership, §D.4 use restrictions.

title: Service Specific Terms
note: Ref [5]. §17.a competitive use, §17.b model restrictions and distillation exception, §17.c reverse engineering, §18 training limits, §20.a definition of Generated Output.

title: Terms of Service

title: The False Promise of Imitating Proprietary LLMs
note: Ref [7]. arXiv:2305.15717. Experiments spanning 0.3M-150M tokens of imitation data; style transfers but factuality does not; the phrase "an unwieldy amount."

title: Stealing Part of a Production Language Model
note: Ref [8]. arXiv:2403.06634. Recovery of the embedding projection layer via ordinary API access; full matrix of small models obtained for under $20.

title: Safety Alignment Should Be Made More Than Just a Few Tokens Deep
note: Ref [9]. arXiv:2406.05946. Alignment sits shallowly over the first output tokens, undone even by benign fine-tuning. Does not measure transfer through distillation.

title: Subliminal Learning: Language models transmit behavioral traits via hidden signals in data
note: Ref [10]. arXiv:2507.14805. Trait transfer even via number-sequence data; the paper's own limit: no observed effect when teacher and student have different base models.

title: Antidistillation Fingerprinting
note: Ref [11]. arXiv:2602.03812. Critiques the quality-vs-strength tradeoff in existing fingerprinting; token selection accounting for what a student is likely to learn. Presupposes planting by the teacher in advance.

title: Real Money, Fake Models: Deceptive Model Claims in Shadow APIs
container-title: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security
note: Ref [12]. arXiv:2603.01919 (v2). Identified 17 shadow APIs used by 187 papers, 3 audited. MedQA Gemini 2.5 Flash 83.82% official vs 36.95% average (gap 46.51-47.21pp), LegalBench 40.10-42.73pp, 45.83% of 24 endpoints failed fingerprint verification, 12.50% further anomalous.

title: Adversarial Distillation of American AI Models (NSTM-4)

author.family: Executive Office of the President, Office of Science and Technology Policy

Industrial-scale distillation by "foreign entities, principally based in China," "tens of thousands of proxy accounts," judgment that distilled models do not replicate full performance yet enable comparable-looking products at a fraction of the cost, and four administration commitments.
